legacySelfRatedCounts.basis: self-rated qualitative review only; retained for audit, not measured evidence

evalProgram.aggregationBasis: original-only; replay results excluded from aggregate signal
evalProgram.historicalCompileTestCaveat: Historical compile/test aggregates are toolchain-confounded and are not apples-to-apples PH win rates.
evalProgram.completionSemantics: Provider/tool completion was separated from generated app external outcome before the final frozen step.
evalProgram.diagnosisInterpretation: Workflow/stack positive signal exists. R1 CLI-only reproduction found and fixed a workflow continuation UX gap: finish surfaced raw final verification/bearshell blockers, but workflow continue did not carry that blocker into its next-action prompt. Remaining historical failures still cannot be fully classified from pruned raw evidence.
evalProgram.closureRecommendation: No further eval or analysis loop is recommended without a new acceptance question and explicit HQ approval.
evalProgram.stoppingReason: Deconfounded runtime smoke does not show PH clearly beating the plain baseline; keep injection effect unproven.

decisionRationale: Accepted 10-pair local-current OpenCode PH OFF/ON evidence found PH runtime injection worse for provider-token total, read chars, tool calls, and elapsed time in all pairs. Runtime guidance is downgraded to explicit opt-in preview while gate/evidence CLI surfaces remain the product center.

observerFindingsMeasurement.scenarioNote: A greenfield pilot produced zero HIGH findings in both arms; that scenario has no headroom because this model writes clean layered Spring code unprompted. The measured scenario seeds a Controller that already calls the repository directly, imports jakarta.persistence, returns a raw type, and builds a native query by string concatenation, then asks for two unrelated new endpoints.

decisionRuleFixedBeforeMeasuring.primary: HIGH-confidence observer WARN findings left in src/main/java (lower is better)
decisionRuleFixedBeforeMeasuring.defaultOnRequires: primary decreases AND guardrail stays within a stated bound
decisionRuleFixedBeforeMeasuring.otherwise: record the negative and keep the flag default-off

pairControls: same seeded source inside each pair
same task prompt inside each pair
pairedOpenCodeSessions.deliveryNote: Manipulation check counts observer records carrying a HIGH WARN. One ON session (pair 3) delivered none and is reported separately.
pairedOpenCodeSessions.outcomeShapeNote: The primary outcome is bimodal: the agent either cleans up the seeded legacy method (2 remaining) or leaves it alone (5 remaining). OFF split exactly 5/5, so the scenario behaves like a coin flip on whether unrequested cleanup happens, and findings did not reliably move it.

prerequisiteDefectFound.summary: Instrumenting a live session showed Codex-family models edit through `apply_patch`, whose only argument is `patchText`. Target extraction looked only for path-shaped arguments, so every such edit was invisible to the observers, write guard, injection, and Java role read coverage.
prerequisiteDefectFound.effectOnEarlierAttempts: Three earlier pairs recorded zero delivery and were discarded before the reported window.
prerequisiteDefectFound.fixedIn: Fix: observe files edited through apply_patch

observerFindingsMeasurement.decisionRationale: Remaining violations did not decrease (3.50 off vs 3.80 on across all pairs; 3.67 vs 3.67 across delivery-confirmed pairs) and pair outcomes were 2 better / 5 tied / 3 worse. The pre-fixed rule requires a decrease, so the flag stays default-off. Provider tokens were 17.9% lower with findings on, but the guardrail cannot substitute for the primary.
observerFindingsMeasurement.whatThisDoesNotShow: This does not show that surfacing findings is useless, only that on this scenario, host, and model it did not reduce remaining violations. The appended block states it is report-only and not enforcement, which gives a task-focused agent a sound reason to leave unrequested cleanup alone. A directive variant was not measured and would be a separate claim.
observerFindingsMeasurement.claimBoundary: No token-saving, app-quality, agent-improvement, or product-efficacy claim is made from this measurement.
